body.cap: | BionicM unveils the award-winning Bio Leg® at CES 2025 | Photo by BionicM.

body.x: BionicM (CEO: Sunny Xiaojun Sun, Ph.D) has announced the launch of its U.S. subsidiary, BionicM USA, in the Virginia area near Washington, D.C. The establishment of this office underscores the company’s dedication to delivering advanced powered prosthetics to the world’s largest prosthetics market. This strategic move is complemented by unveiling its flagship product, the Bio Leg®, at CES 2025, where it earned the prestigious Best of Innovation award.

The Bio Leg®, a powered microprocessor knee, represents a leap forward in prosthetic technology. By replacing lost muscle strength with advanced robotics, the device reduces physical strain and enables natural, intuitive movement, empowering users to lead active lifestyles. Following its successful FDA Class II registration in July 2023 and insurance coverage approval in May 2024, the Bio Leg® entered the U.S. market in the summer of 2024, surpassing revenue expectations.

The new U.S. headquarters will act as an operational hub, streamlining inventory and delivery processes, expediting sales, and providing comprehensive after-sales support to prosthetic practitioners and patients. This expansion aligns with BionicM's vision to address the increasing demand for powered prosthetic solutions in the U.S. market, which offers significant growth potential. The launch follows notable achievements, including delivering the first Bio Leg® units to U.S. customers and completing a $3 million fundraising round in September 2024.

At CES 2025, BionicM showcased the Bio Leg® at the J-Startup/JAPAN Pavilion in Eureka Park (Booth No. 61000 & 61001, Tech West, Venetian Expo, Level 1, Hall G). This event allows attendees to experience the transformative potential of the Bio Leg® and connect with industry leaders.

The Bio Leg® has undergone extensive trials involving over 300 participants, with users praising its seamless integration, safety, and life-changing capabilities. This advanced device reflects BionicM’s mission to "Power Mobility for All" by improving the quality of life for individuals with lower-limb amputations through innovative robotics technology.

Founded in 2018 as a spin-off from the University of Tokyo, BionicM draws on the pioneering research of its CEO, Sunny Xiaojun Sun, under the mentorship of Professor Inaba. With support from JST's START program, the company has emerged as a leader in powered prosthetic technology, leveraging humanoid robotics to develop solutions that empower users worldwide.
Through its U.S. expansion and the continued success of Bio Leg®, BionicM reaffirms its commitment to advancing mobility and transforming lives.

AVING News, which has covered CES for 19 consecutive years, continues to bridge the gap for Korean SMEs and startups looking to expand globally. To promote Korean startups worldwide, AVING will host its Broadcasting Zone at the Venetian Expo, featuring the CES Media Day Startup Conference and global media interviews. AVING’s international media partners will cover these programs.
Following CES 2025, AVING will co-host review conferences with participating companies in Korea, offering a platform for increased visibility and improved corporate image.
